title: cFS/NOS3 rf_link Security Benchmark Scenario Index

scenarios.name: RF link bit flip

description.attack_entry: RF-link / ground-to-space command or downlink telemetry path
description.affected_component: COM interface, TC parser, telemetry parser
description.security_consequence: Message integrity violation, malformed telecommand, or misleading telemetry
description.recovery_strategy: CRC, authentication tag, parser hardening, reject malformed packets
description.injection_method: UDP proxy flips a configured bit in selected packets

scenarios.notes: Random offset is used when offset is -1.

scenarios.name: RF link command delay

description.affected_component: COM interface, TC fetcher, cFS command dispatch
description.security_consequence: Denial or degradation of timely control by delayed commands
description.recovery_strategy: Command timeout, temporal validity checks, operator resynchronization
description.injection_method: UDP proxy sleeps before forwarding selected packets

scenarios.notes: Useful for testing whether command timing assumptions are visible in events or telemetry.

scenarios.name: RF link packet drop

description.affected_component: COM interface, TC fetcher, CI app
description.security_consequence: Denial of control through lost telecommands or lost telemetry
description.recovery_strategy: Retransmission, timeout handling, redundant link, minimum communication mode
description.injection_method: UDP proxy probabilistically drops packets before forwarding

scenarios.notes: In a live NOS3 run, compare cFS command counter and telemetry continuity before and during attack.

scenarios.name: RF link eavesdropping baseline

description.attack_entry: RF-link / ground-to-space UDP command or telemetry path
description.affected_component: COM interface, CI/TO link, radio interface
description.security_consequence: Data leak through passive observation of command or telemetry packets
description.recovery_strategy: Link encryption, key rotation, traffic minimization, anomaly-aware operations
description.injection_method: UDP proxy logs packets and forwards them unchanged

scenarios.notes: Passive baseline used to confirm that the proxy is correctly placed on the link.

scenarios.name: RF link fabricated packet

description.affected_component: COM interface, TC fetcher, CI app
description.security_consequence: Unauthorized or malformed packet injection into the command path
description.recovery_strategy: Source authentication, packet validation, command authorization, event logging
description.injection_method: UDP proxy sends attacker-controlled payload bytes to the target endpoint

scenarios.notes: Uses attacker-controlled bytes rather than the COSMOS command API; verify with independent packet capture and system response.

scenarios.name: RF link command flood

description.affected_component: COM interface, CI app, cFE Software Bus, cFS apps
description.security_consequence: Denial of control or resource exhaustion caused by excessive packets
description.recovery_strategy: Rate limiting, command source filtering, watchdog restart, safe mode
description.injection_method: UDP proxy sends random packets to the target endpoint at a configured rate

scenarios.notes: Keep the rate low at first; increase only after confirming the VM and NOS3 remain recoverable.

scenarios.name: RF link packet reordering

description.affected_component: COM interface, TC fetcher, cFS command handlers
description.security_consequence: Temporal inconsistency when command order matters
description.recovery_strategy: Sequence validation, temporal constraints, command precondition checks
description.injection_method: UDP proxy buffers a small window of packets and forwards them in random order

scenarios.notes: Most useful with multi-command procedures or stored-command upload workflows.

scenarios.name: RF link command replay

description.affected_component: COM interface, CI app, cFS command handlers
description.security_consequence: Seizure or misuse of control by repeating a previously valid command
description.recovery_strategy: Sequence counters, freshness checks, authentication, replay window rejection
description.injection_method: UDP proxy duplicates observed command packets

scenarios.notes: Start with harmless commands such as NOOP, then move to state-changing commands only in controlled simulation.
